name: fatfish-desktop
description: FatFish desktop client for the MiniMost chat server (Windows, fully local)
author: FatFish contributors

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run pack && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../packaging/make-installer.ps1
scripts.render-smoke: tsc scripts/render-smoke.tsx src/global.d.ts --outDir .render-smoke --rootDir . --module commonjs --target es2022 --jsx react-jsx --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node && node .render-smoke/scripts/render-smoke.js
